findings.issue: Chart Editor has no save functionality. No Ctrl+S handler, no Save() method, no integration with BackupManager. User requirement states 'los backups solamente deben generarse cuando el usuario presione Guardar' (backups only when user presses Save), but there is no Save button or keyboard shortcut implemented. BackupManager is implemented but unreachable.
findings.location: ChartEditor.cs - entire file (no Save method exists)

findings.issue: FnmmSaver does not exist. FnmmLoader.Load() is implemented but there is no corresponding FnmmLoader.Save() or FnmmSaver.Save() method to write .FNMM files back to disk. User requirement states 'Guardar los cambios en el formato correspondiente' (Save changes in correct format). Even if ChartEditor had a Save button, there is no underlying code to serialize and write levels to .FNMM ZIP archives.
findings.location: Missing file: FnmmSaver.cs or FnmmLoader.cs (no Save method)

findings.issue: BackupManager.CreateBackupIfNeeded() is never called anywhere in the codebase. User requirement states 'crear una copia de seguridad antes de modificar el archivo' (create backup before modifying file). The BackupManager class is fully implemented with correct logic (only creates backup on first save, preserves original forever), but it has zero call sites. Without Chart Editor Save functionality, the backup system is non-functional and original levels can be overwritten without protection.
findings.location: Entire codebase (grep search found zero calls to CreateBackupIfNeeded)
